name: Implementation (SDLC Phase 7)
description: Building the product features and functionality — aka Build, Delivery, Engineering Execution, Construction, Maker Sprint.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Implementation
capabilities.description: Delivers the working software, technical specifications, and engineering decisions that turn the backlog into a functioning product.

checklists.name: Implementation (SDLC Phase 7) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for feature implementation, code review, and automated unit testing.

items.statement: The implemented code conforms to the documented API contracts and architecture decision records.
Every pull request requires at least 1 peer approval and passing CI build before merging.
Unit and integration test suites meet minimum code coverage target (>= 80%).
Database migration scripts are tested for both upgrade and rollback paths.
No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or unhandled exceptions exist in merged feature branches.

reviewGates.name: Implementation Review
reviewGates.statement: The Source Code has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Quality Engineering & Hardening.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Source Code meet the technical specifications, coding standards, and architecture decisions for this feature set?
